name: Trader Joe's Cauliflower Gnocchi (High Cassava & Insoluble Fiber Warning)
whyItWorks: While marketed as a health food, this gnocchi is 75% cauliflower combined with dense cassava flour and potato starch. It delivers 6g of dense, fermentable insoluble fiber per cup, triggering intense abdominal gas, bloating, and painful distension.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger Warning: Avoid during active flares. If eating in deep remission, pan-sear in olive oil until crispy and eat in a small 1/2 cup portion.
watchOuts: High cruciferous cauliflower and dense cassava starch provoke severe bloating and intestinal spasms.
